sources.locator: Purpose, worked example, Evaluation, Usage and option summary

scientific_use: Estimate whether two genomic interval sets overlap more than expected given their interval coverage and genome size, producing counts, a contingency table and Fisher exact-test tail p-values.

inputs: Two sorted BED/GFF/VCF interval collections and chromosome-size genome file.
